sources: Owner-approved twin-valley story and art plan, 17 November 2026
name: The Windward Cave
description: A sheltered cave in the valley's northeastern highlands, above a green meadow and a small mountain stream. Rounded hills rise to bare mountains and snow-capped peaks along the border.
arrival: Three heads turn together at the cave mouth. Yamantaka makes room beside the windbreak. Beyond him Mirlepa sits in the lee of the rock; cool grass bends toward the sound of running water.

sub_locations.name: The open threshold
sub_locations.description: A clear passage between the windbreak and the hearth.

sub_locations.name: The meditation alcove
sub_locations.description: A dry sheltered shelf with room to sit without blocking the doorway.

sub_locations.name: The resting fold
sub_locations.description: Low hurdles outside the sleeping place, empty between the herder's visits.

notes: Permanent High Camp-like home; visitors rotate, the cave and two Denisovan residents do not. No separate interior field map. Historical northwest id retained for existing diaries and relationships; the household now lives in the northeast.
